name: Agent Tool Call
description: One agent tool call as a flight-recorder line: mono tool name, argument summary, live duration and a status glyph that morphs through queued, running, done and failed.

props.name: seq
props.description: Position in the log, shown as a two-digit index on wide containers.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool name, set in mono. read_file, web.search, bash and sql.query get realistic sample arguments, output and errors.

props.name: args
props.description: Flat arguments. Shown as a one-line summary and, expanded, as tinted JSON. Defaults to the sample for the tool.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status. Omit it to let the component track its own status, which Retry drives.

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Recorded duration once the call has finished. While it runs, the line counts live; without it, a finished call shows the time it was observed running.

props.name: result
props.description: Output of the call. Six lines show at first, with the rest one click away in a scroll area that keeps the page still.

props.name: stderr
props.description: Standard error. A failed call shows its last four lines beside a Retry button.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Whether the arguments and result panel starts open.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height and type size. Compact fits a dense log; comfortable suits a single call on its own.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the line sits on, so its text, rules and tints keep their contrast.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the arc of a running call and the tint behind arguments. Light theme darkens it for text.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Required to show Retry. When uncontrolled, resolve only after the operation succeeds and reject on failure. With a controlled status, the host must update it; settling this callback does not change controlled status.

props.name: retryLabel
props.description: Label on the retry button in a failed call.

props.name: retryingLabel
props.description: Label on the retry button while the retry runs. The button keeps its width, and the error above stays visible, dimmed, until the call lands.
